test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V live on seven different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. U lives on the top floor. Only two persons live between T and Q. Q is on floor number 3. V lives on the floor immediately above P's floor. S lives on the floor immediately above R's floor. Q lives on the floor immediately below R's floor. Who lives on floor number 6?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• P, Q, R, S, T, U and V live on seven different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. 
 
• U lives on the top floor. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f68f399b6baa4aafc55acd6ab0a6b7c3e8f0be12afe5780932fa9917a2509986.png] 

 
• Only two persons live between T and Q. Q is on floor number 3. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91d13830fc1c54fd41527f64aad32b938954f35978fe9919ee07cd2655f4e84c.png] 

 
• V lives on the floor immediately above P's floor. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea0731cfd51f089a39c88d47b82f1b2984fe81e01a125770e2d815da06b3d260.png] 

 
• S lives on the floor immediately above R's floor. Q lives on the floor immediately below R's floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c74a98a3fe6e7bf57b54ab5fb4ae7f59e5fb3e5f87c2b85144e79c75176da057.png] 

​So,** T lives on floor number 6.**

Therefore,** the correct answer is option 4.**
